base.stop_condition: latest origin/mainが変わったらrebaselineしてから静的判定を再実行する

phase_inventory_snapshot.gaps: 旧世代にはpost-deploy evidenceと計画があったが、現行Web-OS authorityへの適合は未評価。 deployment authority、tenant/runtime境界、実装・検証は未成立

denominator.pool_coverage_statement: PHCAP-15 pool 78件について、第六束SCF-B-0065の#2013 merge後に既レビュー6束70件と最終候補8件を静的に照合した。pool全体を候補分類済みとして保持するが、正式な採否・authority・implementation・degradationはroot reviewへ保留する。

products.boundary: 工程・artifact内容・consumer条件の境界候補。配布運転を所有しない候補。
project authority、release準備、artifact受渡し、deployment evidence統制の候補。展開先runtime authorityを吸収しない。
利用者向けWeb体験の候補。直接deployment evidenceの不在は未実装を意味しない。
tenant/service runtime、配備、監視、復旧の候補。OSとはauthority/stateを分離する。

source_anchors.meaning: reviewed-safe source records static false-positive dispositions and content digests
toolchain oracle text rejects old runtime authority while preserving provenance and rollback checks
research adoption table maps proposal patterns to sources and incorporation decisions
shrink terms enumerate wording that must not reduce required coverage
test defines source paths for L0-L8 design consistency audit
test keeps version-up parked and future labels while checking source text
test imports hybrid recognition scanning and reviewed-safe disposition surfaces
test requires technology authority candidates to remain false positives with pinned digest
plan lint test imports governance and schedule lint surfaces with typed status contracts
test checks active docs for forbidden stale trace and stub patterns
doctor test imports checker surfaces and filesystem evidence helpers
test rejects hybrid self-evaluation provider mismatch
task classification test covers proposal coverage and model-policy inputs
test asserts disjoint worker ownership and no closing authority
version-up readiness test imports activation and dry-run readiness surfaces
test checks repeat dry-run output and blocked-reason state

prohibited_inference: pool membership is a phase classification candidate only and does not create a requirement link or product owner
source presence, design text, plan text, implementation/test references or old command claims do not establish current implementation, operation, acceptance, deployment or pass
source snapshot preservation or historical decision records do not create current authority or requirement adoption
phase candidate targets do not admit an asset to PHCAP-15
product candidate membership does not create authority, owner or routing
empty consumer_refs and pending closure do not prove no historical consumer
no failure receipt does not prove no historical failure or rollback
missing direct Web evidence does not establish non-implementation
archive is static reference only and not runtime, test, CI or fallback
